summary: Implemented the books extension's first hook (validate-evidence-append-only.sh, a bare-registered PreToolUse Write|Edit guard) blocking any modification or deletion of a committed line in books/book-convention-evidence/NN-*.md while permitting pure appends. Built its 29-assertion forgery-probed fixture suite, wired manifest.json and a new settings-hooks.json fragment, and verified a real deploy into the consumer repository: registration bare and joined to the existing Write|Edit matcher block, idempotent across a second deploy, and the deployed hook proven to refuse a real modification and allow a real append against a real committed evidence file with the file itself never touched.

artifacts.summary: Books extension's first hook plus fixture suite, manifest/settings-fragment wiring, and a verified live deploy.
PreToolUse Write|Edit hook enforcing append-only evidence files via a FLOOR/DISK/TAIL byte-string predicate, two fail-open guards, and a three-fact rejection message.
29-assertion fixture suite: 11 behavioral cases, 3 forgery probes, 2 fail-open cases, 2 buried-long-line cases.
